from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal

class MonthlyRegionStart(BaseModel):
    """A single data point representing housing starts for a specific region and month."""
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the statistical release was published (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve precedence rules")
    month_covered: str = Field(description="The month the data corresponds to, formatted YYYY-MM")
    region: Literal["South", "Northeast", "Midwest", "West"] = Field(description="The geographic region associated with the data point")
    housing_starts: float = Field(description="The number of not seasonally adjusted single-family housing starts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_housing_starts: List[MonthlyRegionStart]
